answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 52785 Country: India Title: Zakat on behalf of wife to my brother Question: My wife has jewels for which zakah is obligatory. She is housewife. I am only earning members. So can I give zakah for her with her permission? My brother is studying in college. Can I give zakah money to him to pay fees? Is it necessary to inform my wife to whom I am giving her zakah? Answer ID: 52785 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 858/574/L=07/1435) (1) It is not wajib on you to pay the zakah of the jewelleries available with your wife. However, if you pay the zakah with the permission of your wife then zakah shall be paid. (2) If your brother is poor then you may give him the amount of zakah. He can pay his fees with it after it is given into his complete possession. If you pay his fees directly then it shall not be paid. However, the zakah will be paid if your brother appoints you as his wakil to pay the fees. (3) It is not necessary. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
